symptom: PC in VLAN 10 cannot ping PC in VLAN 20. Gateway ping works for both.
topology_note: Two PCs on same switch. Router connected via trunk. Sub-interfaces configured on router.
show_output: show interfaces trunk: VLAN 10 allowed, VLAN 20 NOT in allowed list
expected_fault: VLAN 20 missing from trunk allowed list

symptom: All PCs on VLAN 10 cannot get an IP address via DHCP. Static IP works fine.
topology_note: Router is DHCP server. PCs are on different subnet than router DHCP interface.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool: network 192.168.10.0/24 configured. show interfaces gi0/1: ip helper-address missing
expected_fault: ip helper-address not configured on router interface facing clients

symptom: PC can ping gateway but cannot reach internet. Other PCs on same VLAN work.
topology_note: Single PC issue. NAT is configured on border router.
show_output: show ip nat translations: no entry for PC IP 192.168.1.50. show access-list 1: permits 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.63 only
expected_fault: PC IP 192.168.1.50 is outside the NAT ACL range (/26 only covers .1-.62)

symptom: PC gets IP but browser shows DNS error. Ping to 8.8.8.8 works fine.
topology_note: DHCP pool configured on router.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool LAN: dns-server field is empty
expected_fault: No DNS server configured in DHCP pool

symptom: New access switch connected to distribution switch. All ports stuck in Blocking state.
topology_note: Distribution switch is root bridge. New switch has higher priority value set.
show_output: show spanning-tree: new switch elected as Root Bridge. Distribution switch ports in Blocking.
expected_fault: New switch has lower priority value causing it to win root election

symptom: HSRP standby router becomes Active even though primary is still up.
topology_note: Primary router came back online after reboot. Preempt not configured.
show_output: show standby: R2 is Active, R1 is Standby despite higher priority
expected_fault: preempt not configured on primary router so it stays Standby after recovery

symptom: SSH connection to router times out. Telnet works.
topology_note: SSH configured but connections rejected.
show_output: show ip ssh: SSH disabled. show running-config: no crypto key present
expected_fault: RSA key not generated (crypto key generate rsa missing)

symptom: EtherChannel between two switches not forming. Ports show as individual links.
topology_note: LACP configured on SW1 as active. SW2 config unknown.
show_output: show etherchannel summary: no port-channel. show interfaces fa0/1: not part of channel
expected_fault: SW2 has PAgP desirable configured instead of LACP — protocol mismatch

symptom: PC cannot ping default gateway. IP address and mask are correct.
topology_note: PC is on 192.168.10.0/24. Router interface gi0/0 is 192.168.10.1/24.
show_output: show interfaces gi0/0: line protocol is down
expected_fault: Router interface gi0/0 is administratively shut down

symptom: OSPF neighbors not forming between R1 and R2. Both have OSPF enabled.
show_output: show ip ospf neighbor: empty on both routers
expected_fault: Area ID mismatch — R1 in area 0 and R2 in area 1 on the same link

symptom: PC in VLAN 30 cannot ping PC in VLAN 10. Inter-VLAN routing configured via SVI on Layer 3 switch.
topology_note: SVIs created for VLAN 10 and VLAN 30. ip routing enabled.
show_output: show ip route: VLAN 30 network present. show interface vlan30: line protocol is down
expected_fault: VLAN 30 not created on the switch (VLAN not in VLAN database)

symptom: Extended ACL blocking all traffic including traffic it should permit.
topology_note: ACL applied inbound on gi0/0.
show_output: show access-lists: ACL 110: deny ip any any hits increasing. permit statement is below deny
expected_fault: Deny statement placed before permit statement — first-match kills all traffic

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi users can access internal server at 10.0.0.5. Security violation.
topology_note: Guest VLAN 99 should be isolated from internal VLAN 10.
show_output: show access-lists: no ACL applied to VLAN 99 SVI. show ip interface vlan99: no access-group
expected_fault: ACL not applied to guest VLAN SVI interface — guest isolation failure

symptom: PC gets APIPA address (169.254.x.x) instead of DHCP address.
topology_note: DHCP server is on a remote router (different subnet). Relay agent should forward DHCP.
show_output: show ip interface gi0/1: no helper-address. show ip dhcp binding: no entry for PC MAC
expected_fault: ip helper-address missing on the local router interface

symptom: Routing table on R2 missing the 10.0.0.0/8 network. R1 has it. OSPF is running.
topology_note: R1 and R2 are OSPF neighbors (FULL state). R1 gi0/1 facing the 10.0.0.0 network.
show_output: show ip ospf interface gi0/1: passive-interface set on R1 gi0/1
expected_fault: passive-interface configured on the network-facing interface — OSPF not advertising

symptom: NAT translations not happening. Inside hosts cannot reach internet.
topology_note: NAT overload configured. ACL 1 permits 192.168.0.0/24.
show_output: show ip interface gi0/0: ip nat outside NOT configured. gi0/1: ip nat inside configured
expected_fault: ip nat outside not applied to the WAN-facing interface

symptom: PC1 pings PC2 successfully but PC2 cannot ping PC1 back.
topology_note: Standard ACL applied incorrectly.
show_output: show access-lists: ACL 10 denies 192.168.20.0/24. show ip interface gi0/0: ACL 10 out
expected_fault: Standard ACL placed close to source instead of destination — blocking return traffic

symptom: After VLAN 40 was added to the network no PCs in VLAN 40 can communicate.
topology_note: VLAN 40 created. Access ports assigned. Trunk link between switches exists.
show_output: show interfaces trunk: VLAN 40 not in allowed VLAN list on trunk between SW1 and SW2
expected_fault: VLAN 40 not added to trunk allowed list — traffic cannot cross to the other switch

symptom: PC cannot reach DNS server at 8.8.8.8 but can ping it by IP.
topology_note: DNS server reachable by IP (ping works). Browser shows cannot resolve domain.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool: dns-server 8.8.9.9 (typo — wrong DNS IP in DHCP pool)
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS server IP configured in DHCP pool

symptom: Two PCs assigned the same IP address causing intermittent connectivity for both.
topology_note: DHCP server and a static IP assignment both assigned 192.168.1.10.
show_output: show ip dhcp conflict: 192.168.1.10 detected. show ip dhcp binding: 192.168.1.10 leased to PC-A
expected_fault: IP conflict — 192.168.1.10 not excluded from DHCP pool but manually assigned to PC-B

symptom: ACL blocks telnet correctly but also blocks OSPF hellos — neighbours dropping.
topology_note: Extended ACL applied inbound on gi0/0. OSPF uses IP protocol 89.
show_output: show access-lists: deny tcp any any eq 23. permit ip any any MISSING — implicit deny hits OSPF
expected_fault: Permit statement missing before implicit deny — OSPF packets (IP proto 89) being dropped

symptom: PC in VLAN 10 gets correct IP via DHCP but cannot reach the router gateway.
topology_note: PC is in VLAN 10. Router sub-interface gi0/0.10 configured for VLAN 10.
show_output: show interfaces gi0/0.10: encapsulation dot1Q 20 (wrong VLAN tag)
expected_fault: Sub-interface gi0/0.10 has dot1Q encapsulation set to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10

symptom: Wireless laptop connected to AP but cannot get IP from DHCP.
topology_note: AP is in VLAN 50. DHCP server serves VLAN 50 from router.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool: network 192.168.50.0/24 configured. show interfaces trunk: VLAN 50 missing from trunk
expected_fault: VLAN 50 not allowed on trunk between switch and router — DHCP Discover never reaches router

symptom: R1 has a static default route to the ISP but internet traffic still fails.
topology_note: Static default route configured. ISP interface is up.
show_output: show ip route: 0.0.0.0/0 via 203.0.113.1. show ip nat translations: empty. show ip interface gi0/1: no nat outside
expected_fault: NAT not configured — traffic leaves but has private source IP which ISP drops

symptom: OSPF adjacency stuck in EXSTART state between R1 and R2.
topology_note: Routers connected directly via serial link.
show_output: show ip ospf neighbor: state is EXSTART. show interfaces se0/0: MTU 1500 on R1, MTU 1476 on R2
expected_fault: MTU mismatch between the two interfaces — OSPF DBD exchange fails

symptom: STP PortFast port receiving BPDUs and going into error-disabled state.
topology_note: BPDU Guard enabled on access port. Another switch accidentally connected to that port.
show_output: show interfaces fa0/2: err-disabled. show log: BPDUGUARD-3-DISABLE triggered
expected_fault: BPDU Guard shut the port because a switch was connected to a PortFast access port

symptom: PC can reach servers in its own VLAN but not any other VLAN. Router-on-a-stick is configured.
topology_note: Trunk link between switch and router is correct. Sub-interfaces exist.
show_output: show ip route on router: only directly connected routes. No static or dynamic routes for remote VLANs
expected_fault: No default route or inter-VLAN routing — router only knows directly connected networks

symptom: After adding a new router to OSPF area 0 some routes are missing from its routing table.
topology_note: New router R3 added. OSPF hello and dead timers different from other routers.
show_output: show ip ospf neighbor: neighbor relationship in INIT state. show ip ospf interface: hello 10 dead 40 on R1 / hello 30 dead 120 on R3
expected_fault: OSPF hello/dead timer mismatch prevents adjacency from forming

symptom: PAT is configured but only the first two hosts can reach internet simultaneously.
topology_note: PAT configured using a pool of 2 IP addresses without overload keyword.
show_output: show ip nat translations: 2 entries only. show running-config: ip nat inside source list 1 pool POOL (no overload)
expected_fault: overload keyword missing from NAT command — pool of 2 IPs exhausted instead of PAT

symptom: PC can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot browse any websites. Ping to google.com fails.
topology_note: NAT working. Internet connectivity confirmed via IP ping.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool: dns-server not configured. ipconfig on PC: DNS server 0.0.0.0
expected_fault: No DNS server assigned to PC via DHCP — name resolution fails

symptom: Switch port connected to PC shows up/up but PC gets no IP and cannot communicate.
topology_note: Port assigned to VLAN 10. DHCP server serves VLAN 10.
show_output: show vlan brief: VLAN 10 not in active state. show vlan id 10: VLAN not found in VLAN database
expected_fault: VLAN 10 was never created on the switch — port assigned to non-existent VLAN

symptom: After replacing a failed switch all trunk ports stay in access mode.
topology_note: New switch connected. DTP negotiation expected to form trunks automatically.
show_output: show interfaces gi0/1 switchport: mode dynamic auto on both sides
expected_fault: Both sides set to dynamic auto — DTP will not form trunk without one side being desirable

symptom: Two branch offices cannot communicate via site-to-site VPN. Tunnel is up.
topology_note: GRE tunnel is up. IPsec not configured.
show_output: show interfaces tunnel0: up/up. ping across tunnel: works. show crypto ipsec sa: no SAs
expected_fault: GRE tunnel unencrypted — traffic going across internet without IPsec
